items.title: A $22 Billion Fund Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDarsana Capital Partners, a $22 billion fund, made SpaceX, Amazon and HCA Healthcare its three biggest new or added positions in its latest 13F, for the quarter ended June 30. SpaceX alone was nearly 78% of its 13F stocks, and analysts’ average target sits 84% above the latest close, even with the stock down 19% since June 30.

items.title: Amazon (AMZN) Has Its First Binding Union Contract In North America
items.summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) warehouse workers in Canada have secured the company's first binding union contract in North America. The contract covers hundreds of employees, setting out wage terms and added protections after regulator intervention in the bargaining process.
